items.title: Why is Malaysia sending back Rohingya refugees to Myanmar?
items.description: Kuala Lumpur calls it a voluntary process, but many are raising safety concerns.

items.title: What we know about the attempted hijacking of a Flydubai flight to Tel Aviv
items.description: A flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia after one of the pilots stabbed the other. Israeli authorities have not ruled out the possibility of a terrorist attack or a suicide attempt.

items.title: Russia launches largest attack on Ukraine energy infrastructure since spring
items.description: In total 11 regions of the country were attacked overnight, with residential buildings and railways also targeted, the Ukrainian PM says.

items.title: Malaysia: UN agency urges safeguards after refugees returned to Myanmar
items.description: The UN refugee agency, UNHCR, has voiced concern over Malaysia’s decision to return 1,476 people to Myanmar amid an ongoing civil war and a dire human rights and humanitarian situation.

items.title: Why is the US withdrawing its troops from Iraq?
items.description: A US-led coalition deployed in Iraq more than a decade ago to fight jihadists concluded its mission on Wednesday, a move celebrated by the country's leaders, but which some fear will embolden pro-Iran armed factions. France 24's Angela Diffley takes a look at the security challenges facing the country and why the US ha…

items.title: Ireland will boycott Eurovision again because of Israel's participation, but the song contest is still expanding
items.description: The 2026 Eurovision Song Contest was marred by boycotts in protest against Israel's participation in the midst of its war on Gaza. It still aims to keep growing.

items.title: U.S. military withdraws from Iraq two decades after invasion
items.description: 23 years after the United States military invaded Iraq, sparking an insurgency and a civil war, the U.S. has withdrawn its forces, as the country still tries to combat Iranian influence.

items.title: Putin Envoy, U.S. Officials Discussed Ukraine War and Energy Initiatives, U.S. Official Says
items.description: Dmitriev had meetings with representatives of the U.S. Treasury and Energy departments during his visit to Washington, sources told Reuters.

items.title: As Russia Targets Civilians, Pressure Mounts On Trump To Use Sanctions Powers
items.description: A new wave of deadly Russian attacks on Ukrainian cities is fueling bipartisan calls in Washington for US President Donald Trump to use sweeping new sanctions powers against Moscow, with lawmakers arguing that greater economic pressure could strengthen efforts to end the war.

items.title: Why island nations are the real winners as UN wraps up
items.description: The U.N. hears that a billion people are on the front line as sea levels rise due to climate change.

items.title: What Matters More to Putin? Russian Refineries or Striking Ukraine?
items.description: Kyiv Post Senior Defense Correspondent Stefan Korshak joins TVP World to discuss whether an energy ceasefire could pave the way for broader negotiations, how Ukrainian strikes are affecting Russia’s war economy, and why the Kremlin continues to favor military pressure over compromise.
